Survival game workbench

One engine, one set of rules, many doors into it. The game is played by chapter; the systems that every chapter shares (fighting, raiding, destruction, the mountains) each have a place of their own to work on them, and whatever is tuned there is what the chapters run on. The editors change how things look and how places are made.

Play

The game as it is played, from the wreck.

Chapters 1 and 2The gameThe starter island and the big island: land with nothing, gather, hunt, build a home, meet Arnor, cross the water; the big island's villages, its small mountain, the troll's cave and the copper.

Systems

Each a part of the game set up to be worked on by itself. They share the engine and the numbers with the game, so what is fixed here is fixed everywhere.

CombatCombat ArenaThe fight on its own: beasts and men against you, hirdmen beside you, every weapon, shield and gear, the clock slowed, the blows drawn and written down. Dodging, parrying, blocking, moving. Chapter 3: raidingBattle testMen in the real game: one, two, five against five, a town defended, a raid on it, walking in unarmed, a night raid, storming it. The ways they come at you, what he carries and wears. Chapter 3: raidingDestruction EditorBreaking in, bringing down, burning and mending: a sampler of every wall and roof, the town, fire and wind, every number of the rules as a slider, the big trials. Chapter 2Big island testThe game started on the big island at a carver’s bench with every rune known: the arm ring, the mountain, the cave and the troll, the furnace and the charcoal. MountainsMountain testA mountain island of its own: foothills, the plateau, the peaks, slopes, sea cliffs, the waterfall, the lookout, the old mine, the rock shelter and the sea cave.

Editors

How things look and how places are made. Each hands its result to the game with "Use in the game".

Art EditorThe Blender models (the hero and his gear, the beasts, the people) and the world's drawn objects: pick, tune, walk and fight with it, hand it to the game. Village EditorThe rules that grow a village: an archetype, a seed, the wealth and the shore; the yard, the longhouse, the houses, the fences and the people. Sea EditorThe islands and the sea between: sizes and distances, the villages planned on them, the ships and their handling, the Shipyard.
